_comment: Allowed values of the lane-level task (Milestone 5): the ego lane as a whole, both of its boundaries and the guidance markings inside it. The labeling tool (lane mode) and the answer schema of prompts/lane_v1 read this file. Values describe what can be seen; what they mean comes from the rule passages. Directions are seen from my car, looking forward.

marking_groups.arrow: lane-use arrow painted in my lane (two_way_left = the pair of opposite left-turn arrows of a two-way left-turn lane)
marking_groups.no_turn: a prohibited-movement marking in my lane (China: yellow arrow with a yellow X)
marking_groups.text: words painted in my lane (ONLY, BUS ONLY or 公交, HOV or 多乘员, STOP, KEEP CLEAR, a speed number, other words)
marking_groups.symbol: a symbol painted in my lane (HOV diamond, bicycle symbol, other)
marking_groups.area: a marked area my lane leads into, borders or contains (China: left-turn waiting area ahead of my lane; United States: two-way left-turn lane directly to the left of my lane; grid or box; chevron or diagonal channelizing area)
marking_groups.line: a line across my lane (stop line, yield line, China stop-and-yield line with the character 停, crosswalk)

_stop_first: stop_first = allowed only after a full stop (a STOP word or the China stop-and-yield line with 停 in my lane): every movement the lane allows becomes stop_first.
